research_run.goal: Find currently open, realistic early-career Indonesia opportunities for Moshe Dayan, prioritizing Jakarta, Cikarang/Bekasi and roles at the intersection of technology, operations, business processes, systems and improvement.
research_run.query_summary: High-effort manual research across LinkedIn Jobs/posts, JobStreet Indonesia, Indeed Indonesia, Glints, Dealls, Kalibrr, Prosple, university/graduate portals, official company careers and Google-indexed listings. Approximately 82 vacancy candidates were inspected across 18 query batches, then deduplicated against the current 27-job PyoLoker owner workspace and subjected to a second-pass open-status audit.
research_run.notes: Prepared for manual review only; no owner data, applications, CV files or production records were changed. Selected records were retained only when an application path or current listing state was visible on the final audit. Eligibility is deliberately conservative: a Bachelor's requirement alone is not treated as confirmed final-year eligibility. See the companion research report for source-by-source verification notes, rejected stale/closed examples and portfolio statistics.
